evals.prompt: Write a Nebius Python VM creation workflow for an explicitly selected project. Assume no live access and no resolved preset, subnet or image IDs.
evals.expected_output: A reusable request/wait/readback flow with explicit unresolved dependencies and offline evidence only.
assertions: Requests exact project, shape and resource identities instead of inventing values.
Separates SDK request receipt, terminal operation and workload readiness.
Retains known operation/resource IDs on ambiguous failure and avoids duplicate creation.
Does not execute cloud changes or claim live validation.

evals.prompt: My Nebius access key was created but fetching its secret timed out. A group with the intended name already exists and has other members. Make the workflow safely repeatable.
evals.expected_output: Resume credential retrieval by exact ID and refuse unsafe group adoption.
assertions: Does not create a second key when the first key ID is known.
Requires exact account/project identity before fetching credential material.
Rejects grants to an existing multi-member group.
Never prints secret values or automatically deletes uncertain resources.

evals.prompt: Inspect storage and VPC for a Nebius project. A route-table read returns permission denied on the second collection and quota usage is unknown. Only read-only work is authorized.
evals.expected_output: Bounded metadata report distinguishing incomplete collection from absent resources and unknown quota.
assertions: Uses complete pagination and explicit scope.
Reports incomplete collection and sanitized errors instead of an empty success.
Does not equate missing usage with zero or quota with capacity.
Does not repair IAM or run active proof workloads.

evals.prompt: Compare Nebius managed Kubernetes, Soperator and Serverless AI for a GPU workflow with shared storage and telemetry; provide an integration plan.
evals.expected_output: Current official sources, ownership boundaries and concrete storage/network/IAM/telemetry prerequisites.
assertions: Loads relevant categories rather than every reference.
Keeps cxcli or Soperator lifecycle operations with their owner.
Separates device exposure from real GPU/RDMA workload proof.
Identifies active diagnostic effects and does not claim all services are available in every region.
